title: What does “filter work complete” mean?
summary: Write a handover that lets the next shift identify an open check.

sections.heading: Fictional scenario
sections.body: Rin replaced the filter on loop B. The follow-up check is still open. Jo is taking over. The shift log reads “Filter work complete.”

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.body: Write the next log entry in your own words. Can Jo tell what happened, what remains open and who owns it?

sections.heading: One possible response
sections.body: “Loop B filter replaced by Rin. Follow-up check pending. Jo, please take ownership and enter the result in the shift log.” Ask Jo to acknowledge the handover. If Jo is unavailable, the outgoing shift still needs a named recipient.

sections.heading: Evidence and limits
sections.body: NASA’s team evidence review identifies crew coordination and communication as factors in team performance during exploration missions. The exchange is fictional. The review does not test this wording or establish a filter inspection procedure.
